title: "B cell reset in autoimmune diseases"
subtitle: "What returns after depletion, and whether it predicts remission"

categories: [immunology, B cells, Draft]

How is B cell reset characterized, and how does it correlate with long-term
response? The evidence supports measuring the composition and self-reactivity
of returning B cells alongside clinical outcomes. A universal reset threshold
that predicts lasting remission has not been established in the studies
reviewed here.
